section.title: Not sure what to say?
section.subtitle: Here are some popular ideas for your business

page.title: Post ideas
page.forCategory: Ideas picked for a {category} shop. Choose one to start a post.
page.forAny: Ideas for any small business. Choose one to start a post.
page.loadError: We could not load ideas right now. Please try again.

newArrivals.title: Show New Arrivals
newArrivals.description: Highlight your latest collection or products.
newArrivals.prompt: Create an Instagram post showcasing my new {noun}.

bestseller.title: Feature a Bestseller
bestseller.description: Spotlight the item your customers buy again and again.
bestseller.prompt: Create a post highlighting my bestselling {noun}.

productStory.title: Tell a Product Story
productStory.description: Share where an item comes from and why you love it.
productStory.prompt: Write a post telling the story behind one of my {noun}.

announceSale.title: Announce a Sale
announceSale.prompt: Create a post announcing a sale on my {noun}.

weekendOffer.title: Weekend Offer
weekendOffer.description: A limited-time deal that gives people a reason to visit this weekend.
weekendOffer.prompt: Create a weekend offer post for my {noun}.

bundleDeal.title: Bundle Deal
bundleDeal.description: Pair two or more items at a better combined price.
bundleDeal.prompt: Create a post about a bundle deal on my {noun}.

happyCustomer.title: Share a Happy Customer
happyCustomer.prompt: Create a post sharing a happy customer review of my {noun}.

askOpinion.title: Ask Your Followers
askOpinion.description: Ask which design or flavour they like best and invite comments.
askOpinion.prompt: Create a post asking my followers which of my {noun} they like best.

behindScenes.title: Behind the Scenes
behindScenes.description: Show how the shop runs, from unpacking to the shop floor.
behindScenes.prompt: Create a behind-the-scenes post about my shop and my {noun}.

quickTip.title: Give a Quick Tip
quickTip.description: Share useful tips related to your business.
quickTip.prompt: Create a short tip post that helps customers choose the right {noun}.

careGuide.title: Care & Storage Guide
careGuide.description: Show customers how to look after what they buy.
careGuide.prompt: Create a post with simple care tips for my {noun}.

mythBusting.title: Busting a Myth
mythBusting.description: Correct a common misunderstanding about your products.
mythBusting.prompt: Create a post that busts a common myth about my {noun}.

festivalWish.title: Celebrate an Occasion
festivalWish.description: Wish your audience on festivals or events.
festivalWish.prompt: Create a festive greetings post for my customers with my {noun}.

giftGuide.title: Gift Guide
giftGuide.description: Suggest gifts from your shop for a special day.
giftGuide.prompt: Create a gift guide post with ideas from my {noun}.

seasonLaunch.title: Seasonal Launch
seasonLaunch.description: Introduce your range for the coming season.
seasonLaunch.prompt: Create a post launching my new seasonal {noun}.

visitUs.title: Invite People to DM
visitUs.description: Invite local people to message you to order or ask about it.
visitUs.prompt: Create a post inviting people nearby to DM me to order the {noun}.

milestone.title: Share a Milestone
milestone.description: Celebrate a thank-you moment with your community.
milestone.prompt: Create a thank-you post to my customers, with a line about my {noun}.

collab.title: Local Collaboration
collab.description: Feature a neighbouring business or creator you work with.
collab.prompt: Create a post about a local collaboration featuring my {noun}.
